 Walmart Brings Back Its Holiday Meal Basket: Price and What’s Included
 English 
 04/11/2026 
 English 
 Written by 
 Bibiana Palacios 
 Walmart's Holiday Meal Basket includes more items than last year's edition while keeping its price affordable 
 Agregar Merca 2.0 en Google Photo: Walmart 
 Preparing a holiday dinner can involve significant expenses and hours of planning, especially when it comes to gathering enough food for the whole family. To make things easier during the 2026 holiday season , Walmart is once again offering its traditional Holiday Meal Basket , which brings together the ingredients needed to prepare a Thanksgiving dinner . This year’s bundle also features more items than the previous edition while keeping the price affordable . Here’s everything you need to know.
 ALSO READ   Costco Thanksgiving Dinner: How Much It Costs and What’s Included 
 How much does Walmart’s Holiday Meal Basket cost? 
 The Holiday Meal Basket costs $35 and is designed to serve a holiday dinner for 10 people. That works out to approximately $3.50 per person, making it an affordable way to plan a family celebration while sticking to a set budget.
 What does Walmart’s Holiday Meal Basket include? 
 The 2026 edition features 26 products from well-known brands and Walmart’s own private labels, selected to help prepare a variety of dishes commonly served during the holiday season. The selection includes ingredients for side dishes, main courses, and dessert.
 Here’s what it includes:
 The centerpiece : Butterball turkey, priced at just 97 cents per pound — the same price as last year.
 Classic sides : Stove Top stuffing, cranberry sauce, mashed potatoes and gravy, green bean casserole made with trusted brands like Campbell’s Cream of Mushroom Soup, and warm dinner rolls.
 More holiday favorites : Sweet potato casserole topped with Jet-Puffed mini marshmallows and corn casserole made with JIFFY corn muffin mix.
 A sweet finish : Pumpkin pie with whipped topping.
 When will Walmart’s Holiday Meal Basket be available? 
 Customers can purchase the Holiday Meal Basket now through December 24, 2026. The promotion is available at Walmart stores and online , where shoppers can also choose express delivery to have the products brought straight to their homes.
 Walmart Store Hours 
 Most  Walmart locations  operate from 6:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m. every day of the week.
 How many Walmart stores are there in the United States? 
 Currently, the supermarket chain has over 4,500  stores  in the  United States . The state with the most Walmart locations is  Texas , with a total of 514 stores, representing about 11% of the company’s stores in the country.
 History of Walmart 
 Walmart  was founded by  Samuel Moore Walton , who worked various jobs from a young age to support his family, including selling milk, magazine subscriptions, and even working as a waiter in exchange for meals while pursuing his studies.
 When he was a sales apprentice at  JC Penney , his boss told him that he didn’t have the necessary skills for retail, but years later, Walton would go on to found the world’s largest supermarket chain.
 In 1962, Walton founded Walmart with the vision of bringing  discount stores  that existed in big cities to small towns, offering products at affordable prices. The success was so overwhelming that, within less than a decade, the company began trading on the New York Stock Exchange. By 1991, Walmart surpassed Kmart and Sears in sales, becoming the largest retailer in the United States.
 When is Thanksgiving Day 2026? 
 Thanksgiving Day is celebrated every year on the fourth Thursday of November. In 2026, it will fall on Thursday, November 26.
 Origin of Thanksgiving Day 
 The  origin of Thanksgiving  dates back to 1621, when  English colonists  from  Plymouth  and the  Wampanoag  people gathered to share a meal after a successful harvest season. Although the story has been romanticized over time, this gathering is considered the symbolic beginning of the holiday. Throughout the centuries, different presidents declared days of thanksgiving, but it was  Abraham Lincoln  who, in 1863, officially established a national date to promote unity during the  Civil War .
 Is Thanksgiving Day a federal holiday? 
 Yes.  Thanksgiving Day  is a  federal holiday  in the United States, which means government offices, banks, and nonessential public services remain closed. It is also a day off for millions of workers, although some sectors such as hospitals, transportation, and restaurants may operate with reduced hours. As a federally recognized holiday, public-sector employees typically have the day off with pay.
